name: swimreader-frontend-lint
description: Lint config for the wwwroot frontends. There is no build step — the pages are served to the browser exactly as they sit on disk — so this package exists only to run ESLint.

scripts.//: max-warnings pins today's dead-code count (see eslint.config.mjs). It is a ratchet: lower it as dead code is removed, never raise it.
